notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Dear Players!
New update (1.2.1211.0) is live.
Some of you have reported to us that there has been a problem while loading the chapter 45 "Rays" from time to time. It is now working fine.
Also, some Secret Digits are now easier to find. We found that the level of difficulty in this regard was too high.

Good luck in the Institute ventures...

notes.title: Gamers, assemble! We need your support!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/2e02086af27c0bd148e16aff321cbb7d41bec17c.png

Don’t adjust your screens and refresh the browsers or Steam clients!  
You’re seeing well, this devlog is about something totally different than usual!

On the occasion of the ongoing campaign on Kickstarter, we’re helping our brother, Climber: Sky is the Limit, get some well-deserved attention! 


Our studio, together with A2 Softworks, didn’t expect the project to be nominated in 2 categories on such prestige event as gamescom 2021. Nominations gave us a lot of motivation, and fuel for future development but like in every game cycle, there is a time when developers need some help from their community. 

This time has come for us, that’s why we would like to invite you all to Climber: Sky is the Limit’s campaign on KICKSTARTER! 

For the next few weeks on Kickstarter, we’re going to collect funds and feedback from the gamers to polish the game and astonish everyone with its final form! 

At this stage of development, all help is welcomed. That’s why if you can’t (or don’t want to) help us through Kickstarter but you’re willing to support us in any form, even a small action like leaving feedback or adding the game to your wishlist on Steam will help us a million! 


Follow the project’s campaign on Kickstarter and get notified at launch!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/747a63af8f66a33e4aa84f83babfb423941002e6.png


Add the game to your Wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1231840/

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1176.0 (Y axis and radiation fix)
notes.content:
HELLO COMRADES!
New hotfix (1.0.1176.0) is live,
From now on if the game saves the radiation on a high level, it will be automatically lowered, so you'll be able to survive after loading the save file with the high amounts of it. 
In addition, you'll be able to invert Y-axis in the Controls menu.

Sorry for the inconvenience.
Good luck in the Institute ventures...

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1161.0 (defalut language)
notes.content:
HELLO COMRADES!
Hotfix (1.0.1161.0) is live, 
From now on if English/Russian/Polish is not your system language, the default game language will be English (instead of Polish, as it was before).

Sorry for the inconvenience.
Good luck in the Institute ventures...

notes.title: S.W.A.N. Autumn Game Festival Live Chat
notes.content:
Live Chat
Join the developers of S.W.A.N. in the live chat, share your thoughts, opinions and get answers to your questions!

About S.W.A.N.
S.W.A.N. (Syndrome Without A Name) is a science fiction FPS puzzle horror game, which takes place a few months after the Chernobyl Nuclear Plant disaster. It is a tale of an unexplored area within the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone – The S.W.A.N. Institute, where research was conducted on the rarest and most dangerous cases ever seen in the medical world. Unexplained phenomena and anomalies closed behind the Institute’s doors mark the beginning of a story about fighting for survival at the borderline between humanity and an unknown power, which takes us on an increasingly abstract and psychological journey through a reality separated from our own.
